# KMP Terminal Emulator

> Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) terminal emulator engine and Compose Multiplatform GPU-accelerated canvas renderer.

## Architecture
- `terminal-core`: Pure Kotlin Multiplatform emulation state machine, screen buffer, ANSI parser, and text selection models. Zero UI dependencies. Targets: JVM, Android, WasmJS, iOS, macOS Arm64/x64, Linux x64.
- `terminal-ui`: Compose Multiplatform canvas renderer, gesture detectors, platform native input capture, and selection overlays.
- `terminal-tui`: Terminal User Interface (TUI) engine featuring differential ANSI renderer, 24-bit TrueColor, offscreen grid surface, and VT100/SGR raw input parser.

## Core API References
- [Core Configuration](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalConfig.kt): `TerminalConfig`, `terminalConfig { ... }`, `BellBehavior`
- [Terminal Palette](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalPalette.kt): `TerminalPalette`, `TerminalColor.toRgbInt`
- [UI Configuration](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/ui/TerminalUiConfig.kt): `TerminalUiConfig`, `terminalUiConfig { ... }`, `TerminalGestureConfig` (`touchScrollSendsWheelOnly`), `LocalTerminalUiConfig`, `TerminalCursorStyle`
- [Terminal Color Scheme](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalColorScheme.kt): `TerminalColorScheme`, `TerminalColor.toComposeColor`
- [TUI Surface](terminal-tui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/tui/TuiSurface.kt): `TuiSurface`, `TuiCellStyle`
- [TUI ANSI Renderer](terminal-tui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/tui/TuiAnsiRenderer.kt): `TuiAnsiRenderer`
- [TUI Input Parser](terminal-tui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/tui/TuiInputParser.kt): `TuiInputParser`, `TuiEvent`, `TuiKey`
- [Terminal I/O](terminal-tui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/tui/TerminalIo.kt): `TerminalIo`, `TerminalSize`, `createPlatformTerminalIo`
- [Terminal Emulator](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalEmulator.kt): `TerminalEmulator`, `screenState`, `processOutput`, `processOutputSync`, `packGridToBuffer`, `copyToClipboard`, `copy()` (deep fork), `bellCount`, `clipboardWriteCount`, `lastClipboardWrite`, `currentWorkingDirectory`, `lastExitCode`, `isCommandRunning`, `getPromptMarks`, `findPreviousPromptLine`, `findNextPromptLine`, `extractLastCommandOutput`
- [Screen Buffer](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/ScreenBuffer.kt): `ScreenBuffer`, `getScrollback`, `isRowWrapped(row)`, `getUrlRanges`, `extractUrl`, `UrlRange`
- [Semantic Prompts & Shell Integration](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/SemanticPrompt.kt): `PromptMark`, `PromptMarkType` (`PROMPT_START`, `COMMAND_START`, `OUTPUT_START`, `COMMAND_FINISHED`), `decodeOsc7WorkingDirectory`, percent-decoding
- [Terminal Screen State](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalScreenState.kt): `TerminalScreenState`, `synchronizedOutputEnabled` (DEC 2026), `focusReportingEnabled` (DEC 1004), `cursorShape` (DECSCUSR), `currentWorkingDirectory`, `lastExitCode`, `isCommandRunning`
- [Terminal Cell & Underline Styles](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalCell.kt): `TerminalCell`, `hyperlinkUrl` (OSC 8), `UnderlineStyle` (`NONE`, `SINGLE`, `DOUBLE`, `CURLY`, `DOTTED`, `DASHED`), `underlineColor`, SGR 4:x / 21 / 58:2
- [Cursor Shapes](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/CursorShape.kt): `CursorShape` (`BLOCK`, `UNDERLINE`, `BEAM`)
- [Terminal Canvas & Batching](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/ui/TerminalCanvas.kt): `TerminalCanvas`, `RenderBatch` (`underlineStyle`, `underlineColor`), zero-allocation styled underlines
- [Terminal Renderer](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/ui/TerminalRenderer.kt): `TerminalRenderer` composable, DEC 1004 focus reporting
- [Text Selection](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalSelection.kt): `TerminalSelection`, `SelectionState`
- [Native C-ABI FFI Bridge](terminal-core/src/nativeMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/ffi/TerminalNativeBridge.kt): `terminal_create`, `terminal_copy`, `terminal_destroy`, `terminal_process_bytes`, `terminal_read_grid`, `terminal_extract_selection`
- [Kitty Graphics Engine](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/KittyGraphics.kt): `TerminalImage`, `TerminalImagePlacement`, `KittyImageFormat`
- [Kitty Unicode Placeholders](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/KittyUnicodePlaceholders.kt): `KittyUnicodePlaceholders`, `KITTY_PLACEHOLDER_CODEPOINT`, combining diacritics encoding
- [PNG Decoder](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/PngDecoder.kt): `PngDecoder`, zero-dependency pure KMP chunk parser
- [Zlib Decompressor](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/ZlibInflater.kt): `ZlibInflater`, RFC 1950/1951 Deflate/Inflate implementation
- [Terminal Image Decoder](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/ui/TerminalImageDecoder.kt): `createTerminalImageBitmap`, platform-native ImageBitmap bridge


## Interactive Demos & Previews
- [Live Demo (GitHub Pages)](https://johnan.github.io/kmp-terminal-emulator/): Hosted interactive WebAssembly demo.
- `demo-mobile`: Android & iOS Compose Multiplatform mobile showcase.
- `demo-web`: Kotlin Multiplatform WebAssembly browser REPL demo and JS bridge.
- `demo-jvm`: JVM Desktop Compose Multiplatform demo application.
- `demo-vite`: Modern Vite + TypeScript web integration demo.
- `demo-html`: Minimal vanilla HTML/JS integration demo.
- `demo-rust`: Safe Rust FFI crate (kmp-terminal-rs) and CLI showcase linking against Kotlin/Native libterminal_core.
- `npm-package`: Pre-packaged WebAssembly distribution bundle.
